verdict.rationale: OpenAI Agents SDK is itself an official first-party SDK (Python and JS) with extensive documented primitives (agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, streaming, sessions, tracing, MCP, sandbox/voice agents) and community corroboration of hands-on use, directly fulfilling the 'build against official SDKs' story. missing for 10: broader independent third-party audits beyond a couple of HN threads.
